Question: The traffic on a certain east-west highway moves at a constant speed of \(60\) miles per hour in both directions. An eastbound driver passes \(20\) westbound vehicles in a five-minute interval. Assume vehicles in the westbound lane are equally spaced. Which of the following is closest to the number of westbound vehicles present in a \(100\)-mile section of highway?
